_about: Apps you can add later, from Settings → Desktop → Install apps or `zorro-apps`. Each has extras/<id>/install.sh, run as you (it asks for your password itself when it needs root). how: auto = downloads by itself; manual = you download a file first (download = the page). installed = a file that exists once it is installed.
